rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. The 2 initial pytest ERRORs in test_rbac_and_modules.py (test_client_retail_only, TestScrubDirectPrint.test_client) were caused by pytest-xdist parallel workers generating the same 'TEST_client_{int(time.time())}@test.com' email in the same second → 400 'Email already registered' on the second worker. Fixed by appending uuid4().hex[:8] to the email. Not a product bug.
